Phase 0 diagnostic — manual signaling, no fallback

Host: start the Node spike, choose Host, then Create in the game's lobby. Share its normal room ID.

Guest: generate an offer, send it to the host to paste in their terminal, paste the returned answer here, then load the game and Join using the host's room ID.
